name: Fairmont Sanya Haitang Bay
insider_take: Where tropical luxury meets volcanic heritage on China's southernmost shores
whats_special: This stunning beachfront resort sits on Haitang Bay's pristine 7-kilometer stretch of white sand, backed by ancient volcanic formations that created unique coral reefs perfect for snorkeling. The property features Asia's largest hotel infinity pool and offers unobstructed views of the South China Sea from every oceanview room.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the Willow Stream Spa during sunset hours - the floor-to-ceiling windows overlook the bay, creating an unforgettable golden hour wellness experience that's become legendary among returning guests.
dont_miss: The nearby Yanoda Rainforest Cultural Tourism Zone offers thrilling zipline adventures through 45-million-year-old tropical rainforest, while Wuzhizhou Island (just 20 minutes away) provides some of China's best diving with visibility up to 30 meters and rare giant clam gardens.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on Haitang Bay with pristine white sand beach
Luxurious Fairmont Gold accommodations with exclusive lounge access
World-class spa and wellness facilities with traditional Chinese treatments
Multiple dining venues featuring international and local Hainan cuisine
cons: Remote location requires transportation to reach Sanya city center
